summary.text: 在 Work Item 归档完成后，从既有 Contract、Summary、Outcome 和仓库证据生成可重建的 Implementation Knowledge Record；关闭流程再校验记录与来源 digest，缺失或过期时 fail-closed。

mechanism.text: 生成器只投影已有事实，固定 Contract/Summary/Outcome 与证据文件的 SHA-256 digest；校验器检测来源漂移、证据缺失、身份不一致和索引漂移，历史缺少实现方式的 WI 保留为 partial/unknown。

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Knowledge Record is a rebuildable projection; Contract, Summary, Evidence, and Outcome remain authoritative.
Do not infer missing historical Implementation Approach, Design Reason, current validity, or supersession relationships.
Do not add semantic search, embeddings, LLM ranking, or customer-answer generation to the Core.
Every verified projection claim must retain repository-relative evidence and fail closed when the evidence is missing, stale, or mismatched.
Any adopter-facing runtime/schema/Make capability must be present in the installer catalog and proven by a fresh-adopter parity test.

risk.detail: Projection integrity and installer parity are high-trust surfaces; verified claims are bounded by source/evidence digest checks and close-time validation.

residualRisks.detail: Records generated before merge retain mergedCommit as unknown until a post-merge binding exists; this is explicit and not inferred.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.
expectedReviewFocus: Evidence-bound projection and fail-closed lifecycle placement.
Installer catalog, manifest, schemas, and fresh-adopter parity.

checkpointEvidence.reason: Close-time generation is required so every archived Work Item receives the evidence-bound projection before branch deletion.
Lifecycle integration must generate the projection after archive and validate it before close; a manual-only helper would leave the close gate bypassable.
Explicit user authority has been recorded for the restricted governance paths required by this requested projection and installer surface.
ai-finish source-bound capability refresh generates multilingual and pre-release alignment artifacts; declare these governed outputs so aiScope cannot reject the required refresh.
Coverage guard must know the new projection runtime-to-test association; add the governed policy mapping instead of weakening or bypassing coverage enforcement.
